title: RegBase person record
description: A profile of one named PUBLIC OFFICIAL or STAFF MEMBER who touches oil & gas midstream permitting decisions (elected official, board/commission appointee, or career agency staff) at the federal, state, county, or municipal level in CO/WY/NM/UT/TX. Every fact in this record must trace to a public, professional, role-related source (statute, agency roster, meeting minutes/agenda, published vote, official press release, public campaign-finance filing). See regbase/people/README.md for the full ethics/scope policy this schema enforces.
prohibited_fields: NEVER store: home/personal address, personal phone number, personal email address, family member names or relationships, health information, religion, non-public financial data (bank/asset details beyond what a public campaign-finance filing itself discloses), or anything sourced from a personal (non-official-capacity) social media account. official_contact fields must contain ONLY office-published contact info (agency phone/email/mailing address), never a personal equivalent. campaign_finance must cite only public filings (e.g. state Secretary of State / TRACER / FEC-style disclosure) and must never speculate about a donor's intent or a person's private finances beyond what the filing states. This record exists to understand institutional decision-making PATTERNS AND PROCESS, not to build a personal dossier -- see the 'Prohibited uses' section of README.md, which this schema is bound to.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'co-ecmc-commissioner-seat3' or 'tx-midland-county-judge'. For an unverified placeholder (no full_name yet known), slug on jurisdiction+title, not on a guessed name.

full_name.description: Full name as the office/agency itself publishes it. OMIT this field entirely (do not leave empty string) when the current holder has not been verified via a public source -- leave the record as a title/body placeholder instead. Never infer a name from a stale bio, a news article without a masthead date, or memory/inference.

jurisdiction_id.description: Foreign key to a regbase/schemas/source.schema.json record's 'id' (the regulatory-source entry for the same agency/county). Same slug convention as source.schema.json (e.g. 'co-weld-county-landuse'). May point to a source id that does not exist yet in regbase/sources/ during the people-layer seed phase -- the sources layer is expected to backfill it; do not invent a jurisdiction_id that does not follow the shared convention.

body.description: The decision body or office, e.g. 'Board of County Commissioners', 'Planning Commission', 'City Council', 'ECMC', 'RRC', 'Oil Conservation Division'.

title.description: Official title exactly as the agency publishes it, e.g. 'Commissioner, District 2', 'Director of Community Development'.

term_start.description: Only for elected/appointed seats with a defined term. Omit for career staff or when unverified.

next_election.description: Next scheduled election for this seat, if elected and publicly scheduled.

appointed_by.description: Appointing authority for appointed roles, e.g. 'Governor of Colorado', 'Board of County Commissioners'. Omit for elected/career_staff.

official_contact.description: OFFICE-published contact info only. Never a personal phone/email/address.

mailing_address_office.description: Official office mailing address (e.g. county administration building), never a home address.

staff_or_decision_maker.description: recommends = staff who write recommendations for a body to vote on; decides = has a formal vote/decision authority; advises = non-binding advisory role; administers = runs the process/program without a discretionary vote (e.g. permit intake, inspection).

portfolio.description: Which permit/authority types this person's role actually touches -- reuse regbase source.schema.json's 'authority_type' and 'applies_to' vocabularies where possible.

position_summary.description: Neutral, sourced paraphrase or direct quote (quoted verbatim if a quote) of a position taken in an official/public capacity.

matter.description: Docket/case/agenda item name or number as published.

applicant.description: Public applicant/operator name of record only -- not a private individual.

vote.description: e.g. 'aye', 'nay', 'abstain', 'recused', or the recorded motion outcome for that member.

decision_patterns.description: Aggregated, EVIDENCE-LINKED observations only -- never a characterization of the person, only of the observed public record. Every rate/claim here must be reproducible from evidence_urls.

approval_rate_observed.description: e.g. '9/11 (82%) midstream matters, Jan 2023-Dec 2025' -- state the numerator, denominator, project-type scope, and date window inline. Never a bare percentage.

hot_buttons.description: Recurring, publicly-stated topics of concern (e.g. 'setback distance', 'noise mitigation') -- sourced, not inferred.

campaign_finance.description: Elected officials only, and only from public filings (Secretary of State / state campaign-finance portal / TRACER etc.). Never derived from a non-public source.

notable_energy_sector_context.description: Factual, filing-sourced note only, e.g. 'Filing lists contributions from operators registered in the county per [filing_url]' -- never speculation about intent.

confidence.description: verified = current role/name confirmed directly on the agency's own official page or a primary filing within the last review cycle. probable = confirmed via a secondary but credible public source (e.g. recent news citing the official title) not yet cross-checked against the agency page. unverified = placeholder slot; full_name should be omitted.

review_source_urls.description: URL(s) actually opened to confirm this record as of last_reviewed. Every URL here must be transcribed verbatim from a WebSearch result or direct visit -- never reconstructed or guessed.
